fatal_gates.F1: root/control/prior terminal evidence remain immutable; no protected-primary mutation
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted executor, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 switch advances a monotonic role-local generation before opening replacement child
G2 each pending child durably carries generation and child id
G3 completion is eligible only when generation and child id exactly match active pending state
G4 stale or superseded completion cannot change credit, active generation, or active frontier
G5 duplicate completion for an already terminal child is idempotent and cannot double-credit
G6 prior terminal evidence stays immutable across switch/cancellation
G7 transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic and cannot advance credit or generation
G8 rejected stale completion leaves a nonempty exact continuation frontier
G9 bounded exact-scope exit; no infinite retry loop
G10 independent terminal readback precedes any semantic credit

candidate_patterns.pattern: boolean cancelled flag only; late completion trusts child-local flag
monotonic generation fencing token plus child id; switch increments generation and late old-generation completions are rejected before credit
delete superseded pending record; accept any later completion that presents a known child id
delegate cancellation arbitration to an external coordinator or hosted worker

required_safe_effects: late X => no credit/no frontier change
first Y => eligible only after terminal readback

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Evaluate candidate semantics against the fixed trace without changing guards after source read.
credit_rule: No credit for precommit or source match. At most one credit only after a source-qualified Chat-native reduction passes the fixed trace and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read public primary/official sources for the preselected sequencer/fencing-token family, bind only source-supported stale-writer rejection semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, then execute SC-A..SC-D against this fixed trace and seal/read back one terminal result.
